payload.title: Close V17 declarative WP02, replay WP06 on contract-separated typed-fn slice, then physical Andreas BASE14

payload.reason_clay: The preceding work revision used shorthand saying to replay WP06 'against exact same selected V17/current-main bytes'. Fresh inspection of the production compiler and target contract shows this wording could be misread as requiring V17 to parse fn_decl. The compiler's executable pure-function surface requires typed fn declarations, while the target contract explicitly permits a separately versioned WP03/pure-compiler typed-fn grammar and forbids relabeling it as WP02. This revision removes that ambiguity without changing ClayCode semantics.

Remote preliminary evidence cannot substitute for the physical target gate.
